title: Cloning the Class Github Repository
author: Bonnie L Hurwitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wwiffce

steps.title: Log in to UA HPC portal
steps.instruction: Open a web browser, navigate to the UA HPC web portal, and log in with your credentials.

steps.title: Display and copy SSH public key
steps.instruction: In the portal shell, change to your home directory, then to the .ssh folder, and output the public key file.

substeps.instruction: Copy the displayed key to the clipboard

steps.title: Log in to GitHub
steps.instruction: Open GitHub in a browser, log in to your account, click your user avatar, and select "Settings" from the dropdown menu.

steps.title: Open SSH Keys page
steps.instruction: In GitHub Settings, select the SSH Keys section on the left (or "SSH and GPG keys"), then click the "New SSH key" button in the upper‑right.

steps.title: Add new SSH key
steps.instruction: Paste the copied public key (~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub) into the "Key" field, give it the title "UA HPC", and click the big green "Add SSH Key" button.

steps.title: Clone repository via SSH
steps.instruction: On the UA HPC portal, go to the /rsgrps/bh_class/username directory (replace "username" with your own) and clone your biosys-analytics repository via SSH.

steps.title: Verify password‑less access
steps.instruction: Attempt a git push or pull to confirm you can access the repository without being prompted for a GitHub password.
